evidence.summary: 提供本地优先的跨 Agent 记忆服务、桌面与 CLI 入口，并通过适配接力项目上下文。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、package.json、Memory/src/agent-source/integration/deepseek-harness/target.ts、Memory/src/agent-source/integration/templates/memmy-deepseek-harness-plugin.ts、Memory/src/agent-source/adapters/deepseek-harness/adapter.ts、Memory/src/model/embedder.ts、Memory/src/service/retrieval/retrieval-service.ts、Memory/src/utils/sensitive-data.ts；来源扫描到Memory检索服务，init生成DSH插件/Skill，pre-step召回与turn-end串行捕获。
limitations: 根工程抽查Memory的DSH来源/安装模板、检索过滤和模型数据流，不审整个Agent Runtime、所有平台、账号服务或存储后端，不执行目标代码。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 跨DSH及其他Agent切换的用户希望保留背景、偏好与进度；根是独立应用/服务工程。
来源扫描到Memory检索服务，init生成DSH插件/Skill，pre-step召回与turn-end串行捕获。
根工程抽查Memory的DSH来源/安装模板、检索过滤和模型数据流，不审整个Agent Runtime、所有平台、账号服务或存储后端，不执行目标代码。
private monorepo经桌面/CLI/Memory工具分发，DSH adapter由显式init生成，根不声明直接bundle。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次使用 | 应用/服务/模型与索引；金额未知 | 选来源/模型、备份patch并核范围 | 根不等同DSH单包安装 |
| 持续使用 | 提取/embedding/过滤token和后台资源 | 核出处、错误记忆和预算 | 试用额度不代表免费 |
| 失败恢复 | 索引/模型重试和存储备份 | 停捕获、核来源与服务、撤回记忆 | adapter卸载不删除数据库 |
先观察并画清具体配置的数据流/退出方案，非敏感小样本核来源与纠错后再决定接入。见[Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSH接缝 | 安装生成、pre-step召回、turn捕获 | 实际宿主注入与续作成功 |
| 结构检索 | query向量与可选LLM过滤 | 相对笔记的准确/净收益 |
| 数据控制 | 配置provider和模式脱敏 | 任意敏感数据与全撤回/退出 |
来源scan与运行时bridge分离、同session捕获串行和sourceMemoryIds值得借鉴；模板完整性与原子写入不等于运行兼容/隐私，迁移须核宿主消息/事件契约，见[Q02](#research-q02)。
把跨Agent历史组织为服务化结构记忆并提供DSH自动捕获/召回接缝，增量在连续性与共享状态，而非单纯聊天摘要。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
local-first不等于离线，远程embedding/LLM会接收文本；后台服务与记忆库不会随关窗口或卸载DSH adapter自动消失。见[Q03](#research-q03)。
未验证方向是沿sourceMemoryIds核纠错/撤回传播，区分未来召回与历史已注入；若现有链已足够或无净收益不另建账本。见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: Q01记忆服务/向量检索既有，新意为跨Agent组合小幅9；Q02来源/turn捕获/分层召回为实质机制15，正确性未验不取23；共享runtime bridge与来源adapter跨入口有显著迁移15，但状态契约成本不足20；Q03服务/模型/安装目标复杂，只简化局部操作4不取8。

business.rationale: Q01把换Agent重讲背景转为持久接力为实质流程18，真实继续成功未测不取26；结构记忆可检索交付取实质15而非全部正确；多Agent入口触达实质10；Q03模型/运维净费用未知，仅局部共享经济4。

recommendation.reason: 有本地服务和模型配置经验的跨Agent用户可先观察Memmy的非敏感历史接力，它是独立应用与Memory服务工程。相比手工CONTEXT笔记，它提供捕获和结构检索，但数据外发、错误记忆撤回和完整退出尚未核清。若跨项目误记、旧决策持续召回或后台与模型数据流无法解释，停止捕获并退回手工笔记和原历史，保留库备份再处理。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)明确换Agent重建背景/进度的流程摩擦和合格续作，超泛用途15；独立真实持续收益不够30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)自动捕获/共享runtime与结构检索相对手工笔记有解释性增量超6；准确/纠错未知不支持19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)及[Q03](#research-q03)核心捕获、注入、模型和退出边界可核，高于局部声明6；未运行目标/全链，数据恢复缺口保observe且不取19。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)多服务/模型/来源与数据库状态持续维护，退出/撤回重要缺口低于10；可停止捕获回笔记并备份仍非无退路0。

publication.summaries.text: 提供本地优先的跨 Agent 记忆服务、桌面与 CLI 入口，并通过适配接力项目上下文。

items.后台: 历史来源扫描、Memory服务与结构检索
items.模型工具: 生成的DSH插件提供memory search/get等工具
items.事件监听: DSH轮次召回、捕获与压缩边界

| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |

**English** • [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## What Is Memmy?

### Cross-Agent Task Continuity
### Most of the Agents You're Using Can Connect to Memmy **DeepSeek Harness, OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, WorkBuddy, OpenCode, Pi...they all work!** ![cross-agent-en.png](docs/assets/cross-agent-en.png) ### Data Security ![Memmy data security](docs/assets/data-security-en.png) ## How to Use Memmy For complete installation and configuration instructions, see the [Getting Started guide](docs/en/start/getting-started.mdx). #### 1. Desktop App (Recommended)

Download Memmy from the [official website](https://memmy.bot/) or [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/MemTensor/memmy-agent/releases). > [!TIP] > Sign up for Memmy to receive free tokens and try the complete Memory + Agent Runtime.
> **Trial credits:**
> Registration grants Agent task trial tokens; the current balance and usage are shown in the app.
> When the trial credits run out, switch to BYOK mode and use your own model API. #### 2. Use the `memmy` CLI / TUI ![Memmy TUI](docs/assets/tui.png) On Linux x64 or arm64 with Node.js 22 or newer and an available systemd user session: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MemTensor/memmy-agent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash memmy ``` The installer enables the local Memory Service immediately as `memmy-memory.service`. The first bare `memmy` invocation opens the model setup wizard when needed, then enables `memmy-gateway.service`, waits for it to become ready, and enters the TUI. Both are `systemd --user` services bound to localhost and remain available after the TUI or terminal exits. They start again on later logins; the installer does not enable linger. Only the installer launcher activates this service management, so source-built Linux CLIs keep their existing behavior. Before starting or reconnecting to the Gateway, `memmy` refreshes a private `~/.memmy/systemd/gateway.env` file (mode `0600`) with configuration-referenced environment variables, common Provider credentials, and the terminal `PATH`. If those values change, the next bare `memmy` invocation restarts the user service with the new environment. ```bash systemctl --user status memmy-memory.service systemctl --user status memmy-gateway.service ``` The installer initializes Memory without changing Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or other agents. Run `memmy-memory init` (all detected agents) or `memmy-memory init --agent ` when you explicitly want to install the Memory Skill and the supported Hook/plugin for an agent. ```bash memmy onboard # Configure models, providers, gateway, memory, and tools interactively memmy onboard --defaults # Initialize ~/.memmy/config.yaml and the workspace with defaults memmy status # Check the configuration, model, and provider memmy agent --message "Introduce the current workspace" # Run a single-turn task memmy # Enter the interactive TUI memmy serve # Start the OpenAI-compatible API (:18990) ``` The minimal BYOK configuration is located at `~/.memmy/config.yaml`: ```yaml agents: defaults: model: openai/gpt-4.1 provider: openai timezone: "+08:00" providers: openai: apiKey: ${OPENAI_API_KEY} ``` #### 3. Use the `memmy-memory` CLI Use it to access the local memory service from agents, scripts, and debugging workflows: ```bash memmy-memory init memmy-memory health memmy-memory search "memory policies in this project" memmy-memory add "a piece of knowledge worth saving" memmy-memory get ``` It connects to `http://127.0.0.1:18960` by default. Use `--url`, `--token`, `--config`, `--source`, and `--user-id` to specify the service and namespace. To run the memory service alone, without the Agent Runtime, build the CLI from source: ```bash git clone https://github.com/MemTensor/memmy-agent.git cd memmy-agent npm install npm run memory:build mkdir -p ~/.local/bin ln -sf "$PWD/Memory/dist/src/cli/index.js" ~/.local/bin/memmy-memory memmy-memory install --service-only ``` `install --service-only` downloads the pinned Memory runtime, registers the user-level service, starts it, and verifies `/api/v1/health`, all without installing a Skill or adapter into any agent. Node.js `>=20` is required; use `Git Bash` on Windows. `npm run memory:binary` packages the same CLI as a portable archive under `Memory/src/cli/dist/binaries/` for the current platform, and `MEMMY_MEMORY_TARGET` selects another supported platform. #### 4. Start from the Source Code ```bash git clone https://github.com/MemTensor/memmy-agent.git cd memmy-agent cp .env.example .env npm install npm run build bash scripts/dev-start.sh ``` The script installs dependencies, builds the services, and starts the development environment.
